$comment: The script replaces `{edition}` with the edition it is releasing, which it
reads from the release tag. To add the 2027 edition, add 2027/final/ and
Each key under `deposits` is a separate Zenodo record with its own concept
DOI, read from the environment variable named by `concept_env`. Editions of
one deposit become versions of that record.
Citation metadata comes from CITATION.cff, not from this file.
